scientific_integrity: Closed-form all-size theorem; 323-type independent bitmask cross-check to 15 vertices. The full rank-and-boundary polynomial of Burghart is acknowledged, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The paired-degree reconstruction is restricted to rooted-forest posets of width at most two, and C^2 identification is relative to this class. Earlier specialized coverage may exist.
title: One-round counting fingerprints of rooted-forest ideal lattices of width at most two
